yorke-peninsula-4.name: Edithburgh Jetty
yorke-peninsula-4.bio: Jetty where divers and snorkellers find seahorses, Port Jackson sharks and leafy sea dragons.
yorke-peninsula-4.ticket_note: open public jetty, no single steward site

yorke-peninsula-5.name: Corny Point Lighthouse
yorke-peninsula-5.bio: 1882 lighthouse reserve at the peninsula's south-western corner, reached by Lighthouse Road.
yorke-peninsula-5.coordinates_source: OSM man_made=lighthouse + Wikipedia coordinates within 5 m (HIGH)
yorke-peninsula-5.ticket_note: no verified official page; free self-guided reserve

yorke-peninsula-6.name: Yorketown Pink Lakes
yorke-peninsula-6.bio: Salt lakes on the Yorke Peninsula Salt Lake Trail, with a viewing platform at Pink Lake and a boardwalk at Par Lake.
yorke-peninsula-6.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint "Pink Lake Viewing Area" (MEDIUM; Pink Lake water body -35.041919,137.590479 agrees within 500 m)
yorke-peninsula-6.ticket_note: no single steward; lakes are open roadside
yorke-peninsula-6.notes: Wiki title is the town article (not this place); consider omitting wiki so photo lookup uses name. Par Lake boardwalk not separately pinned.

yorke-peninsula-7.name: Wool Bay Jetty and Lime Kilns
yorke-peninsula-7.bio: Old port jetty and cliff-top lime kilns with a lookout on the coast road.
yorke-peninsula-7.coordinates_source: OSM man_made=pier "Jetty" at Wool Bay (HIGH per resolve-pin; generic name, locality place node -34.98900,137.75371 is ~700 m away)
yorke-peninsula-7.ticket_note: open heritage stop, no steward site
yorke-peninsula-7.notes: Pin is the jetty; lime kilns sit on the cliff top nearby, not separately resolved in OSM.

yorke-peninsula-8.name: Port Victoria
yorke-peninsula-8.bio: Western-coast town, the last windjammer grain port, with an 1878 jetty, a maritime museum and a coastal geology trail.

yorke-peninsula-9.name: Port Victoria Maritime Museum
yorke-peninsula-9.bio: 1877 cargo shed by the jetty telling the story of the windjammer grain races.
yorke-peninsula-9.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum + Wikipedia coordinates (HIGH, ~210 m from the Port Victoria town pin)
yorke-peninsula-9.ticket_note: no official museum website found; only the History Trust SA community-history listing
yorke-peninsula-9.notes: $2.00 per person, family $5.00, child $0.50 from History Trust SA listing (may be dated). National Trust museum; open weekends afternoons per Atlas note.

yorke-peninsula-10.name: Minlaton Harry Butler Red Devil Memorial
yorke-peninsula-10.bio: Free display of the Red Devil monoplane that made the first airmail flight over the sea.
yorke-peninsula-10.coordinates_source: OSM (Nominatim) "Harry Butler Red Devil Memorial" building, Maitland Road Minlaton (MEDIUM)

yorke-peninsula-11.name: Port Vincent
yorke-peninsula-11.bio: Seaside town on the east coast of the Yorke Peninsula with a beach and jetty.

yorke-peninsula-12.name: Point Turton
yorke-peninsula-12.bio: 1876 jetty still used by fishers and white beaches on Hardwicke Bay, with boating and diving.

yorke-peninsula-13.name: Corny Point
yorke-peninsula-13.bio: Surf breaks and three swimming beaches, with a coastal drive from Corny Point to Berry Bay.
yorke-peninsula-13.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach "Berry Bay" (Nominatim, MEDIUM); town node -34.92633,137.08476 not used so the pin sits on the coast, 1.7 km from the lighthouse
yorke-peninsula-13.ticket_note: coast and town; no single steward

yorke-peninsula-14.name: Black Point
yorke-peninsula-14.bio: Safe white-sand beach with no rips, good for crabbing and swimming, beside Pine Point.

yorke-peninsula-15.name: Sultana Point
yorke-peninsula-15.bio: White-sand swimming beach south of Edithburgh, at the end of the mosaic walking trail.
yorke-peninsula-15.coordinates_source: OSM boundary=administrative "Sultana Point" locality point (Nominatim, MEDIUM; Wikipedia coords -35.11389,137.75944 within 300 m)
yorke-peninsula-15.notes: Locality point, not a surveyed beach feature; verify on map.
